020/**
021 *      PersonCMD <action> <parameters>
022 *  First parameter is the person id. If not person id is given, will use current active person - if any. -dgb
023 */
024public class PersonCMD extends BaseCommandPlugin {
025        
026        //public static Logger log = Logger.getLogger(PersonCMD.class);
027        
028        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
029                
030                if (dialog == null) return false;
031                
032                OptionPanelAPI options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
033                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
034                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
035                CargoAPI cargo = pf.getCargo();
036                
037                if(params == null || params.size() == 0) return false;
038                
039                /* examples calls to handle:
040                 * PersonCMD makeUnimportant gargoyle $reasonFlag
041                 * PersonCMD makeUnimportant gargoyle
042                 * PersonCMD makeUnimportant
043                 * PersonCMD makeUnimportant $reasonFlag
044                 * 
045                 * (also with "makeImportant")
046                 * 
047                 * 1. attempt to get person from dialog
048                 * 2. even if successful, check if first param is a person!
049                 * 3. if no person found during these steps, then Oops!
050                 * 
051                 * next param (which can be param 0) is the action
052                 * next param is whatever else ie. reason. This is optional, of course.
053                 */
054                
055                MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
056                if (memory == null) return false; // should not be possible unless there are other big problems already
057                
058                PersonAPI person;
059                String action = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap); // action is always param 0
060                int paramsUsed = 1;
061                SectorEntityToken entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
062                
063                if (entity.getActivePerson() == null || params.size() > 1) {
064                        String id = params.get(paramsUsed).getString(memoryMap);
065                        
066                        // if no person found in dialog, and not person found via param, then what are you even doing here??
067                        if(Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getPerson(id) == null) {
068                                System.out.println("could not find person id: " + id );
069                                return false;
070                        }
071                                
072                        person = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getPerson(id);
073                        paramsUsed++;
074                }
075                else {
076                        person = entity.getActivePerson();
077                } 
078
079                if(person == null) return false;
080                
081                if ("makeUnimportant".equals(action)) {
082                        if(params.size() > paramsUsed ) {
083                                String reason = params.get(paramsUsed).getString(memoryMap);
084                                Misc.makeUnimportant(person, reason);
085                        }
086                        else {
087                                Misc.makeUnimportant(person, "generic");
088                        }
089                        return true;
090                }
091                else if ("makeImportant".equals(action)) {
092                        if(params.size() > paramsUsed ) {
093                                String reason = params.get(paramsUsed).getString(memoryMap);
094                                Misc.makeImportant(person, reason);
095                        }
096                        else {
097                                Misc.makeImportant(person, "generic");
098                        }
099                        return true;
100                }
101                else if ("isContact".equals(action)) {
102                        
103                        // check if a person id was given as a parameter
104                        // if so, we use that instead of the person we're in dialog with
105                        if(paramsUsed == 1) {
106                                String id = params.get(paramsUsed).getString(memoryMap);
107                                if(Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getPerson(id) != null) {
108                                        person = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getPerson(id);
109                                }
110                        }
111
112                        return ContactIntel.playerHasContact(person, false);
113                }
114                
115                return false;
116        }

125}
